reviews.review_description: Power Breeze, an installer in Perth was knowledgeable about solar panels and was very patient in answering my questions prior to me selecting a system.  They demonstrated clarity in quoting by providing a quote in tabular form, with a table of panel options for each inverter, so that I could confidently choose where I wanted to position myself in the tradeoff between price and quality.  Their installers arrived on time and they were courteous.  The pre-install inspection revealed a better (more shaded & sheltered) location for the inverter than I had in mind.  The installation although noisy was quicker than I anticipated, done by 3pm, they worked like a well-oiled machine.  They did not appear to cut corners:  one installer expressed frustration to his colleague at inadvertent damage to a cable, and the entire cable was replaced without hesitation.  I was guided through the operation of the inverter, connecting the inverter to my wifi and installing the inverter's app.  I was also shown the location of the isolator switches.  Changes to the switchboard and isolator switches were all neatly labelled, making for a very professional installation.
The team at PowerBreeze instlled my system with me giving them only a moment's notice. They did a real good job, awesome work by knowledgeable people.
